description: Compare two to five user-supplied pricing or cost scenarios in one currency. Unknown inputs must be null, never guessed zeros or a default currency. If any scenario is incomplete, returns needs_input with labeled questions and no numeric comparison; ask for those inputs. Complete scenarios return contribution, maximum CPA and ROAS. Does not predict sales or change pricing or advertising.

anyOf.description: ISO 4217 currency code; all amounts must use this currency.

currency.description: User-supplied ISO 4217 currency code. Use null if unknown; never assume USD.

anyOf.description: Payment fee as a percentage, e.g. 3 means 3%, not 0.03.

paymentFeeRate.description: User-supplied payment fee percentage: 3 means 3%. Use null if unknown; do not substitute 0.

anyOf.description: Revenue per order after discounts, excluding collected taxes.

price.description: User-supplied revenue per order after discounts and excluding collected taxes. Use null if unknown.

anyOf.description: Product cost per order, including any allocated costs you want to model.

productCost.description: User-supplied product cost per order. Use null if unknown; use 0 only when the user explicitly supplied zero.

anyOf.description: Revenue reserved for refunds as a percentage; this is a simplified reserve.

refundRate.description: User-supplied refund reserve percentage. Use null if unknown; do not substitute 0.

anyOf.description: Net shipping and fulfillment cost per order.

shippingCost.description: User-supplied net shipping and fulfillment cost per order. Use null if unknown; do not substitute 0.

anyOf.description: Desired contribution per order after advertising. Supply 0 for break-even only.

targetProfit.description: User-supplied desired profit per order, or 0 when the user requests break-even only. Use null if unknown.
